claims.text: The main aim of the paper is to rectify the lack of error type analysis in Grammatical Error Correction systems by providing a method for automatic annotation of error types.
The paper introduces ERRANT, a toolkit designed to automatically annotate parallel error correction data with explicit edit spans and error type information.
The paper aims to standardize existing error correction corpora under a common error type framework to improve evaluation and feedback.
